text:
tara_marketing: Quick huddle 1 00% planning to announce Aurora next Wed 09:00 PT. We need: final changelog URL, canonical staging docs link, a single benchmark sentence for the hero, canary + ramp plan, and webinar/demo ownership (30m). Also two email subject line ideas for A/B. :hourglass:

leo_eng: I'll push the changelog. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelogs/pull/621 (final sha `c8a9f11`). Canary plan: 09:00 PT canary 6m, 25% at 09:06, 50% at 09:14, full at 09:30. Fallback tag `aurora-legacy`. Ops should run smoke checks for 20m after full.

anya_docs: Staging docs live at https://docs.redwood.dev/staging/aurora. Added Quickstart + Migration page; will paste the config snippet here in a minute. Marketing, please use this as the canonical link in the announcement draft.

matt_research: Benchmark blurb suggestion: "Aurora cuts token spend up to 2.3x on long-context inference and reduces 95th-percentile latency by ~48% at 16k tokens." I'll run one last overnight regression and confirm final numbers by 06:30 PT tomorrow. If anything changes we'll use cautious language (e.g., "up to"). :bar_chart:

tara_marketing: Nice. We plan public blog + docs at +5m after full, email at +10m, social at +20m, webinar same day 11:00 PT (30m). Evan can you lead the demo? Also need 2 subject lines: A) "Aurora: Faster long-context, lower cost" B) "Ship longer contexts for half the cost 1" Thoughts?

ev an_pm: I can lead the demo; Anya will demo migration steps and Matt will cover benchmarks in the Q&A. I'll own the runbook + rollback steps and publish them here. Email +10m is fine, we'll coordinate with Growth for audience segments.

leo_eng: Runbook note: rollback: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/reinference --to-revision=9`. Post-deploy checks: `curl -sS https://health.prod.redwood.dev/model-route | jq .p95` and KV cache hit-rate metric: `sum(rate(kv_cache_hits[1m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests[1m]))`. Ops on standby for ~30m.

anya_docs: Migration snippet for docs (paste):

```
# aurora example
model:
  name: redwood-aurora
  quantize: true
  kv_cache: auto
```

matt_research: Regression queued; will confirm by 06:30 PT. If numbers hold I'll provide a one-line explainer we can use in the hero (short, non-technical).

tara_marketing: Proposed publish timeline: 09:00 PT canary, 09:30 full, 09:35 blog + docs live, 09:40 email, 10:00 VIP notify, 11:00 webinar. Need final checklist: merged changelog, staging docs URL, benchmark confirmation, runbook + rollback, webinar deck, email subjects. I'll drop announcement draft in this thread for review by EOD. :memo:

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment: release-aurora start=5950012200 canary_window=360s full_rollout=5950012600. CI: all checks green. :white_check_mark:

leo_eng: Heads up: canary toggles a new fused-kernel config; add a smoke to validate p50/p95 + fallback route validation immediately after canary.

ev an_pm: I'll add a short step list to the runbook: pre-flight checks, health queries, validation thresholds, rollback command, and contact list. Will publish link here when ready.

tara_marketing: Thanks all 1 I'll assemble the announcement, include the A/B subject lines, and request final sign-off here tomorrow morning after Matt's confirmation. Ping me with any late changes. :sparkles:
